lines.en: label futabanoongen2:
I tap on Futaba's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Futaba 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hey, Futaba. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba。你在忙什么？

lines.en: : Hi, [futabamaster]. I'm actually glad you called.
lines.zh: : 你好，[futabamaster]。其实你打过来我挺高兴的。

lines.en: : I'm on my way to the bookstore and it would be nice if...you know.
lines.zh: : 我正在去书店的路上，要是……你知道的。

lines.en: : If I came with you?
lines.zh: : 要是我陪你一起去？

lines.en: : Y-Yeah. That.
lines.zh: : 是、是啊。就是这个意思。

lines.en: : If you wanted to, I mean. If you're busy, then-
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果你愿意的话。如果你忙的话，那就——

lines.en: : Sure. Just text me the address and I'll meet you there.
lines.zh: : 好啊。把地址发给我，我在那儿跟你碰头。

lines.en: : Oh! Okay! Sure!
lines.zh: : 啊！好的！就这么说定了！

lines.en: The two of us hang up and I receive a text with the address just a few seconds later...
lines.zh: 我们挂了电话，几秒钟后我就收到了写着地址的短信……

lines.en: scene futabanoongen2
I wind up at the bookstore to find Futaba already browsing one of the aisles on the second floor.
lines.zh: 我到了书店，发现 Futaba 已经在二楼的某个书架间逛了起来。

lines.en: It's a pretty large store, but the layout is simple enough that I was able to find her without any issue.
lines.zh: 店挺大的，不过格局简单，我毫不费力就找到了她。

lines.en: She stops looking around out of courtesy the second I make my way over to her, but I quickly assure her that she doesn't need to stop herself just because I'm around.
lines.zh: 我一走过去，她就出于礼貌不再东看西看了；我赶紧告诉她，用不着因为我在就刻意停下。

lines.en: As such, she proceeds to sift through a bunch of old-looking fantasy novels and asks me a bunch of questions about which ones she should buy.
lines.zh: 于是她继续在一堆看起来有些年头的奇幻小说里翻拣，还问了我一大堆该买哪本的问题。

lines.en: Not knowing much about that genre of literature, I simply choose the ones with the coolest names and, before long, Futaba is spending an absurd amount of money on books.
lines.zh: 我对这类文学所知不多，就干脆挑名字最酷的那些；没过多久，Futaba 就在书上花掉了一笔荒唐的钱。

lines.en: Having hobbies looks expensive.
lines.zh: 有爱好看起来真烧钱。

lines.en: It's times like this that I'm glad I'm really only interested in girls.
lines.zh: 这种时候我就庆幸自己只对女孩子感兴趣。

lines.en: scene black
But, then again, girls can be expensive, too...so I guess I'm not entirely safe from the evils of commerce.
lines.zh: 不过话又说回来，女孩子也可能很烧钱……所以看来我也没能完全逃过商业的魔爪。

lines.en: Thankfully, Futaba has a good amount of money that her parents send her from wherever they are overseas, so she's able to do things like this without much issue.
lines.zh: 好在 Futaba 有不少钱，是她在国外的父母寄来的，所以她做这种事没什么压力。

lines.en: I wind up helping her carry everything as we exit the bookstore and, being the gentleman I am, I even accompany her back to the dorm.
lines.zh: 出书店时我帮她把所有东西都拎上，而且以我这般绅士的做派，甚至还一路把她送回了宿舍。

lines.en: I'm a little distraught that the entirety of our time together today was spent shopping, but...
lines.zh: 今天一整段相处时间都花在了逛街上，我有点郁闷，不过……

lines.en: Well I guess that, more than anything, I'm just glad we got to spend some time together.
lines.zh: 怎么说呢，比起别的，我更高兴的是我们总算一起待了一会儿。

{i}Futaba's affection has increased to [futaba_love]{/i}!
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]{/i}!
